known_limitations: FOLD ERRATUM applied per A1 dispatch amendment 2026-09-29: plan §4 prose 'F10 ends 2025-12-26' was an arithmetic slip; implemented programmatic calendar F1_START=2021-01-04T00:00Z + i*26w, EVAL_END=2025-12-29T00:00Z (Monday-aligned, 10x26w exact). spec.py carries the erratum comment block; test_fold_calendar_erratum_applied pins it.

D1-D8 interpretation register implemented as frozen in plan §1: D1 long-only; D2 SMA = simple MA, time windows in 5m bars (48/288/144/864/24/96) with min_periods=window (any missing slot in the trailing window -> NaN -> ineligible); D3 RSI = two Wilder lines (20 fast crossing above 55 slow, TA-Lib SMA-seed convention, bar-counts on the EMITTED 15m bucket series); D4 'trend' leg = cross-up entry, TP/SL exit, no time stop; D5 $10,000 notional per entry, max 1 position per leg; D6 momentum re-entry requires fresh false->true state-change; D7 'spread turn' = fast-slow spread <=0 -> >0 on consecutive EMITTED clock bars; D8 TP/SL measured from actual fill price.

decision_ts convention (resolution of the plan's 'decision at bar close t executes at open of next 5m bar >= t+5m'): decision_ts = open time of the LAST 5m bar of the decision bar (5m clock: the bar itself); fill at first 5m bar with open_time >= decision_ts+5min. Unified across clocks — for a 4h bucket closing 04:00 the last constituent bar opens 03:55 and the fill lands on the 04:00 bar's open: no skipped bar, PIT-clean.

Final-fold EVAL-wall force-flat: the first 5m bar >= fold-10 end (= EVAL_END = 2025-12-29) exists in the loaded panel but is SEALED; per the sealed-tail law it is never evaluated, so the final force-flat is priced at the LAST IN-WINDOW 5m close (2025-12-28T23:55), exit_ts = that bar's open, reason FORCE_FLAT, fee charged. Same law applied to B1's wall exit (dispatch B1 text said 'first 5m open >= EVAL_END' — that bar is sealed; the hard cap wins; disclosed here). Folds 1-9 force-flat at the literal first 5m bar >= fold_end open.

Positions open when the panel ends before any fold boundary stay OPEN: no synthetic trade record, marked equity only. This preserves the truncation-replay prefix law (a frame-end close would fabricate trades absent from a full run). Real corpus: all folds close in-window, so every scored position closes.

Signals arriving while LONG are DISCARDED (not queued); an entry is actionable iff flat before the fill bar opens (fill bar index > previous exit bar index). Disclosed in counters (signals_discarded_while_long).

Funding: event ts floored to the 8h slot before joining (measured jitter <=47ms; DATA-VERIFY); window (fill_ts, exit_ts] with exit_ts = EXIT BAR OPEN time — events strictly inside the exit bar's own 5 minutes are not charged; contiguous-bar equity marks are consistent with this window (t_close[b] == t_open[b+1]).
PF when there are no losing trades: pf=null plus pf_lossless=true; verdict P2 treats lossless as pass. P6 vacuously true when combo net <= 0 (plan §6 conditions P6 on net > 0).
Terminal outcome: plan §7 categories evaluated in plan order; a bar pattern outside the defined categories falls to COMBO6_UNCATEGORIZED_DEFER_OWNER instead of forcing a fit.

TRIAL_LEDGER rows keyed by cell (6 legs + COMBO = 7); a recomputation replaces the existing row for the same cell rather than appending a duplicate, so observed_scored_denominator counts unique cells computed (budget-honest across reruns). Header counts are rewritten atomically on each scored invocation.

Dry artifact deliberately does NOT serialize the banned-substring list itself (writing the words 'pnl'/'equity'/... into the artifact would self-trip recursive greps); banned_key_count + violations are emitted instead.

23MB m5_panel.parquet build cache is committed per dispatch (staging/ is part of the commit); loader re-verifies all 102 zip sha256s + funding sha256 against the pinned manifest on EVERY load and fails closed (DataDigestMismatch). Parquet roundtrip proven byte-identical to the zip-built panel (same replay digest from both paths).

gap_census cross-check vs DATA-VERIFY: expected_5m_slots=707,616, missing=0, duplicates=0 — exact match. Funding census 7,643 total, 5,460 in [2021-01-04, 2025-12-29) = DATA-VERIFY's 5,451 (counted to the uncorrected 2025-12-26 end) + 9 events in the 3 erratum days.
